answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to permanently destroy native tokens to gain network influence. As the entry cost creates a fiscal spiral that penalizes identity inflation, an attacker faces the prohibitive expense of burning capital to thread fake nodes into the system. Much like the dense, durable structure of cedar wood, this economic barrier remains rigid against unauthorized scaling, ensuring that each node's weight corresponds to an actualized financial commitment.
